rules.noInvention: A generator may not state a figure, a claim or a quote that is absent from this file — not from memory, not from the web, not by inference. If a slide needs a fact that is not here, render the literal marker ⟦FACT NEEDED: <what>⟧ in place of it and tell the user.
rules.noLocalFix: If a figure here is wrong, it is corrected here, not in a slide. A slide that disagrees with this file is the slide that is wrong.
rules.quoteIntegrity: Third-party quotes are reproduced verbatim. They are never trimmed, paraphrased or corrected for house style — banned words inside a quote are the speaker's, not ours.
rules.staleness: Any entry whose asof is more than 6 months old renders with the marker ⟦STALE⟧ next to it.

openItems.why: The editor holds the pen but does not set pricing, validate a security claim or approve a customer quote. Without a named referent per domain and one channel for corrections, this file goes wrong quietly — and a source everyone trusts that happens to be wrong is worse than no source at all.
openItems.assignedTo: Robin Defilhes, for all five domains
openItems.risk: A single validator across Company, Product, Security, Customer proof and Pricing is the bottleneck the internal pitch named: one person cannot rule on pricing, a security claim and a customer quote with equal authority. Accepted deliberately on 2026-09-21. Revisit when the file starts lagging reality rather than when someone complains.

openItems.why: No pricing figure is recorded here. Any slide that needs one renders ⟦FACT NEEDED⟧ until a referent supplies and signs off the numbers.
The deck carries no standing disclaimer beyond the confidentiality footer. If regulated-market slides need one, it belongs here.
